sourceCaption:
Brielle Saracini and Sean McGuire both lost their fathers on 9/11, then met at a camp established to support families affected by the attacks.

Tonight, they threw out the ceremonial first pitches at Yankee Stadium as a married couple ❤️

(via @mlb)
